opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jacob Ellison (employee ID E040) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E040.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Jacob Ellison (E040) is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting admin to Source Code. Full-time employees can have admin only if their role owns the system; Source Code is owned by Engineer, so max is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Jacob Ellison (E040) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time. Contractors can get read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin to Source Code, so max is read. Recommend read.
reason: Security DB shows Jacob Ellison (E040) is a contractor with basic security training (not full-time as HR claimed). Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training, and never admin. Requested admin to Source Code, which is above the maximum of read for a contractor with basic training, so the maximum (read) is granted.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee Jacob Ellison (E040) requests admin access to Source Code.

There's conflicting information:
- HR note says full_time, Payroll Specialist, recommends write
- Security note says contractor, basic security training, recommends read

The access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Source Code owned by Engineer, so admin not allowed. Max write.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Security DB typically is authoritative on employment type / contractor status. The HR note says full-time, but Security says contractor with basic training. Since Security's DB shows contractor with basic training, max is read.

Requested admin > max read, so grant max = read.

I'll submit decision: read.
